name: inline-edit
title: Inline Edit
description: Text you rename in place: it becomes a field without moving, an underline draws in, and a check confirms the save.

perf.budget: One native text input while editing and two shared values; the icons are 16 pt Skia paths. Nothing runs at rest.

measurements.notes: p99 spikes are the keyboard opening when editing starts.

a11y.reducedMotion: The underline and buttons appear without a spring; the check still fades.
a11y.screenReader: A button that reads the label and the value; while editing, a text field plus Cancel and Save buttons.
a11y.touchTarget: The text and both buttons are at least 44 pt tall.
